title: Normalized DNC identity in geometric section coordinates
statement: For P in the finite setting and Y separated finite type over k, let X be ordered affine d-space over Y, p its projection, W=X×_Y X, s its diagonal, and delta the uniquely normalized DNC comparison [thm-pur-dnc-invariance]. For every homogeneous-normalized Rees comparison q, let S and N be the source and normal ordinary-etale geometric section coordinates [def-pur-affine-diagonal-section-coordinates]. Then delta.hom followed by normalComparison.hom and nu*(N.hom) equals sourceComparison.hom followed by nu*(S.hom). This statement contains no integration transpose, Tate orientation, or annihilating exponent.

proof.text: The difference-coordinate isomorphism carries the diagonal pair to the standard affine pair. Apply extended Rees to the isomorphism of pairs. The polynomial formula is y_i-x_i=t*v_i. At one the map is difference coordinates; at zero it is the homogeneous normal-coordinate map, because the normalized Rees comparison preserves each degree-one generator. This identifies the whole family with the standard constant family, including its actual section.

Use the canonical exceptional mate for this family isomorphism and mate pasting with the two fibre squares. Its sectionRestrictionIso readings are the two geometric section comparisons. Apply the normalization equation of the unique DNC arrow at the identity base change, and cancel identity-pullback comparisons. The resulting equality is exactly the displayed equation. Empty lists and empty schemes satisfy the same identities.

theorem affineDiagonalDncCoordinateIdentity (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (d : ℕ) :
    let p := affineDiagonalProjection Y d
    let s := pullback.diagonal p
    let aX := p ≫ aY
    letI := affineDiagonalProjection_smooth Y d
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d p
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P p aY
    let δ := (Dnc.existsUnique_dncInvariance P d (pullback.fst p p) aX s
      (pullback.diagonal_fst p)).exists.choose
    let C := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (affineDiagonalSpace Y d)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ (q : s.ker.normalCone ≅ PurityNormalBundle.normalCone s)
      (hq : Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.ReesConeNormalized s q),
      δ.hom ≫ (Dnc.normalComparison P d (pullback.fst p p) aX s
          (pullback.diagonal_fst p)).hom ≫
        C.map (P.affineDiagonalNormalSectionCoordinates Y aY d q hq).hom =
      (Dnc.sourceComparison P d (pullback.fst p p) aX s).hom ≫
        C.map (P.affineDiagonalSourceCoordinates Y aY d).hom
